title: Phobos upkeep data pack

priority.description: Override files only: files apply lowest first (default 0), so a higher number has a later word. Leave it out unless you need it.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

tuneStep.description: How much of a full tune one session adds (default 0.2).

tuneStepSkilled.description: The same for a crew member skilled at the machine (default 0.3); never less than tuneStep.

inspectionValidHours.description: Game hours an inspection stays good for (default 24).

inspectedFadeShare.description: Share of the ordinary fade an inspected machine's tune takes (default 0.5).

practiceMinutes.description: Game minutes of one practice session at a machine (default 10).

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

gainShare.description: This family's share of the player's MaxTuningGain setting (default 1); 0 leaves it untuned.

families.description: Machine families by key, such as manufacturing.charge; phobosframework upkeep lists them.

description: Crew upkeep: what a tuning session adds, how long an inspection is good, and each machine family's share of the gain.
